story: Lily's favorite blanket could magically turn into a flying carpet.
With a secret flutter, it was also ready for amazing adventures high above the clouds!
She wondered where her magic blanket would take her today, perhaps somewhere she'd never been before?
Just then, the blanket gave a little wiggle, as if it already knew exactly where to go!
The blanket lifted gently, carrying Lily and her teddy bear higher and higher into the soft morning sky.
The air grew cooler and sparkly as they soared past white, fluffy clouds that looked like giant cotton balls.
Suddenly Jill flew by!
Jill gave a friendly wave as she zoomed past on her own little cloud-scooter.
Just as Lily was waving back, something even more amazing twinkled into view from behind a puffy cloud!
A sparkling star-creature, with gentle, glowing eyes, floated gracefully towards them, looking very friendly.
It's name was...
It was named Twinkle, and it sparkled with all the colors of a rainbow.
Twinkle blinked its rainbow eyes and seemed to invite Lily and her teddy bear closer with a soft hum.
Lily looked at her teddy bear, who seemed to nod, and together they decided to follow the twinkling new friend.
Twinkle led them on a gentle path through the sky, and soon, a forest of swirly, red-and-white candy cane trees appeared below!
Each tree twisted and turned like a giant, delicious spiral reaching up to the sky.
Suddenly, a tiny, sad little whisper floated up from the candy cane forest, as if the trees themselves were feeling a bit glum.
Lily looked at Twinkle with a curious frown, silently asking, "What's wrong?"
Twinkle, with a soft shimmer, pointed a glowing antennae towards the forest, as if to say, "Look!"
Peeking through the swirly branches, Lily saw a tiny turtle friend, all curled up and looking a little lost.
The little turtle was snuggled deep inside its shell, looking very shy and a bit worried.
Lily knew just how that turtle felt sometimes, so she gently asked, "Are you okay, little one?"
